_notes.shadow_opacity: Overall shadow strength. Suggested range: 0.10 to 0.25.
_notes.shadow_width: Shadow width as a fraction of character height.
_notes.shadow_height: Shadow depth as a fraction of character height.
_notes.offset_x: Horizontal offset as a fraction of character height. Positive moves right.
_notes.offset_y: Vertical offset as a fraction of character height. Positive moves down.
_notes.softness_layers: More layers create a smoother edge but cost slightly more drawing time.
